decisions.reason: The source explicitly revises the About page, not the FAQ, and the existing FAQ commission copy remains accurate without stating an expiration rule.
The no-expiration rule applies to commissions earned through a used referral code, not the separate allocation made when no code is provided.
The source Event changes commission earning expiration only; it does not alter ticket issuance or the established draw-specific ticket expiration cycles.
Unlimited, non-expiring commission earnings do not change the referral code's identity, permanence, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
The commission expiration decision does not change how prize tickets are allocated when a mint has no referral code.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the About-page statement that referral earnings have no limits and no expiration.
The no-expiration rule affects how long referral commissions may be earned, not the mint price or per-sale revenue allocation amounts.
Commission earning expiration does not change any required NFT metadata field or counter.
The source commission-expiration decision does not resolve or modify the separate uncertainty about automatic versus manual prize delivery.
Unlimited, non-expiring referral commissions do not alter Big Block prize amounts, draw triggers, ticket eligibility, or pool funding.
Unlimited, non-expiring referral commissions do not alter Small Block prize amounts, draw triggers, ticket eligibility, or pool funding.
The commission expiration rule does not change the separate Small Block and Big Block ticket counters or their reset behavior.
